chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from Abd Allah ibn Khidash al-Manqari: that he asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about a man who died and left a daughter and his brother.
He said: 'The wealth belongs to the daughter.'
ai.seo_question: Who inherits the estate when a man leaves only a daughter and a brother?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies the inheritance share of a daughter when no sons or parents are present, ruling that she inherits the entire estate to the exclusion of the brother. This ruling highlights the principle of *al-bint wa-l-akh* (daughter and brother) in Shia jurisprudence, where the daughter’s share is not merely half but the full residue, distinguishing it from the Sunni view where the brother may exclude her or share in specific conditions. The hadith underscores the precision of the Ahl al-Bayt’s interpretation of Quranic verses, emphasizing the daughter’s primary status in the absence of male descendants.
